items.interpretation: docs/MILESTONES.md (Milestone 04, line 71-72) requires a wait-timeout/patience mechanism for NPCs waiting on a table, but does not state a concrete duration. Given the existing spawn interval (NPC_SPAWN_INTERVAL_MS = 2500ms in src/main.ts) and walk-tween durations (WALK_TO_ENTRY_DURATION = 1200ms, WALK_TO_SEAT_DURATION = 800ms in src/game/npc/controller.ts), a patience limit on the order of 15000ms (15s) is likely a reasonable placeholder default for playability, but this is a game-design/tuning choice, not something derivable from the codebase alone.
basedOn: docs/MILESTONES.md:71-72 (M04 waiting-reason + patience requirement, no numeric value given)
